cases.note: the mindustry/ tree with its source roots, no symlinks, VCS metadata or compiled artifacts
every Java source under core/src and server/src compiles offline against the pinned server jar

cases.id: server:the server loads patch files from its asset folder
server:a patch changes a block while its map is hosted
server:a server-defined item can be used by a patch
server:a server-defined item exists while its map is hosted
server:patching a build tower also changes the drones it builds with
server:a planet-restricted patch applies on its planet
server:a patch for another planet is neither applied nor listed

clauses.anchor: Expected behaviour, first bullet: patches can refer to content from the server's content folder and apply without warnings; that content keeps loading
Expected behaviour, second bullet: a patched build tower's builder unit uses the patched build speed and range, restored without the patch
Expected behaviour, third bullet: patches skipped because of requiredPlanets are not listed; unrestricted and planet-matched patches are applied and listed
Expected behaviour, fourth bullet: plain patches apply while hosted and are undone when a map is hosted without them
Server data assets section: reloadassets loads files from config/assets and answers Loaded <n> data asset files.
Context, last paragraph: changes stay inside mindustry/core/src and mindustry/server/src, which the server build compiles
clauses.note: enforced only through the offline build of those source roots
